html_inspection.scope: Rendered HTML and reference inspection; notebook execution received separately.

pilot.methodology: Synthetic 25-atom rigid translations; one warmup then three serial samples; all merges requested for both linkages. Includes validation, unit conversion and optional attribution. Exact source manifest and aggregate resource limits are retained by the enclosing receipt. Not a production workload or installed/platform qualification.

execution_reuse: All scientific implementation and test bytes are identical between the 200-case clean source/HTML checkpoint and the fourteen-fast-gate checkpoint. The latter adds two generated Experimental inventory lines only. The 2,599-case dirty integrated run preceded attribution-helper relocation/import ordering; it is not presented as a new complete passing run of the final commit.
version_provenance_limit: The observed library version comes from another installed development distribution under the controlled source overlay (#657). Actual source commit, complete before/after file manifests and import origins are independently retained. The reported package string is not an exact source identifier.
scientific_scope: No fitting, centering, reflection, periodic imaging, chemistry inference or source edits. Common Cartesian axes are explicitly caller-declared.
Identity and inverse-closed chemical maps are required; oriented witnesses and restricted search scope are retained. Positional comparison claims no chemical equivalence.

Analytic translations, chemical permutation and an independent cross-member linkage oracle validate the bounded declared claims; this does not add registered release scientific gates or certify unrestricted chemistry.
Inclusive exact computed cutoffs, earliest-input merge ties, medoid/first representatives and single-linkage chaining are explicit.
Selected coordinates and dense output remain resident. Numeric work/RAM estimates exclude source and Python objects and total RSS. No new Rust binary or dependency is introduced.
remaining: DockingMT independently receives its saved E2 population on its actual supported runtime/artifact profile.
New pairwise/clustering tools have exactly two explicitly unreceived Viewer addon routes under #421.
Root source-overlay version identity (#657), copy policy (#656), GHECOM intake (#654) and frozen 1.0 installed/platform/human/exact-candidate gates remain separately owned.
